chapter_title: Chương 43: Doanh thu ba vạn ngày đầu

segments.title: Chương 43: Doanh thu ba vạn ngày đầu
segments.content:
Tao Chenggang sat in front of the computer and asked Chen Guiliang, "Which rich person in China has the surname Shi?"

"Who else could it be? Since he gave his surname, it's most likely Giant," Chen Guiliang said.

"Holy crap!"

Tao Chenggang exclaimed in shock.

Ever since Giant went bankrupt and its skyscraper was left unfinished, Boss Shi had become extremely low-key.

The more popular Naobaijin became, the more low-key he was, almost never appearing in public again. Tao Chenggang had nearly forgotten such a person existed.

However, during Tao Chenggang's high school and college days, Boss Shi was an absolutely legendary figure, the kind who appeared in the newspapers every other day.

Tao Chenggang replied on QQ: "President Shi from Giant?"

"Correct," Boss Shi said.

Xie Yang was standing nearby watching. Still young, after all, he asked with a puzzled look, "Who is President Shi from Giant?"

"Naobaijin and Golden Partner," Chen Guiliang said.

Xie Yang uttered a single word: "Fuck!"

Tao Xue, on the other hand, was furious. "Beat him up, his commercials are so annoying!"

"Yeah, beat him up," Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

While the three of them were complaining, Tao Chenggang and Boss Shi had already started chatting.

"Hello, President Shi. I'm A Sword from the West."

"Your network operations are very interesting, refreshing. I couldn't help but want to chat with you."

"You're a senior in the field."

"Haha, I'm a customer of your game. Go check if my top-up went through. Send me the admission ticket to run the Woma Abyss."

"Okay, please wait a moment."

"With the abilities you've shown, it's a waste of talent to just run a private server. Are you interested in joining my team? We can make a legitimate game together."

"You flatter me, President Shi. Compared to the Naobaijin team, we're still a bit too inexperienced."

"Don't be modest. My previous team, including myself, is only familiar with traditional marketing channels. I haven't done much research on internet marketing yet, and I'm in urgent need of an expert like you."

Tao Chenggang turned his head and asked Chen Guiliang, "Should I partner with him?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Gang-ge, you can decide for yourself. But I have to remind you of one thing, Boss Shi is a very dominant person. Once you partner with him, you'll have to listen to him on everything. You'll only be a high-level lackey, with no decision-making power in your future career."

Tao Chenggang thought about it carefully, then continued typing to probe further, "How would we partner?"

Boss Shi said, "Your private server already has a bit of fame, it's definitely going to be crushed by Shanda. When that happens and the players are all riled up, you can take the opportunity to announce you're partnering with me to develop a game. Just use your current method, updating the game's development progress every month, keeping the players hooked until the game goes online. I'll also promote it across the board, on the internet and in the real world."

"I'm asking about the specific details of the partnership," Tao Chenggang said.

Boss Shi retorted, "Besides the marketing and fame of your private server, what else can you bring to the table?"

Tao Chenggang said, "A brand-new online game concept, and an investment of several million."

"What game concept?"

"Confidential."

"My initial decision is to invest a hundred million to make a game. With the few million you invest, plus your game concept, I'll give you company shares depending on the specifics. You can ask around, from when I started my business to now, I've never screwed over a partner."

"A hundred million to make a game?"

"That's right. TV, newspapers, magazines, the internet, even roadside billboards and the sides of buses, will all have my game's advertisement. With such a massive promotional effort, an investment of a hundred million is nothing."

"President Shi, you're awesome..."

Tao Chenggang was completely stunned, already having trouble keeping up with Boss Shi's train of thought.

He put down the keyboard and asked Chen Guiliang, "Is he planning to use the same methods he used to sell Naobaijin to market a game he developed himself?"

"He's the kind of person who would do that," Chen Guiliang said.

Tao Chenggang shook his head, "This guy really is dominant. It wouldn't be interesting to make a game with him, who knows when he'd eat me up, not even leaving a scrap behind."

Chen Guiliang smiled, "He wasn't lying about one thing, he really hasn't screwed over a partner since he started his business. You don't even have to worry about him stealing your game ideas. As long as he thinks they're valuable, he'll definitely give you a corresponding amount of equity. Although the way he sells health products is shady, he's absolutely loyal to his own people."

Hearing this, Tao Chenggang began to hesitate again.

Boss Shi didn't send any more QQ messages, probably having received his admission ticket and gone off to run the instance.

Tao Chenggang asked Chen Guiliang, "If it were you, what would you do?"

Chen Guiliang said, "I wouldn't be anyone's subordinate."

"Me neither. I'd rather be the head of a chicken than the tail of a phoenix!" Tao Chenggang said. "I'll politely decline, and we'll just be friends."

Chen Guiliang smiled, "Don't be in such a hurry to refuse. String him along."

Tao Chenggang asked, "What for?"

Chen Guiliang said, "After things blow up with Shanda, Boss Shi's name will still be useful. Perhaps it could attract a real investor. You could also use him as a gimmick. When you don't have enough funds to make the game, you can just claim that Boss Shi also wants to invest in it."

"I get it." Tao Chenggang gave Chen Guiliang a thumbs-up.

Then, he sent a QQ message, "President Shi, I still need to think about a major decision like this."

About ten minutes later, Boss Shi failed the instance again, and came back to chat, "That's fine, I still need to scout for a development team anyway. Let me ask, what does the Abyss Woma Leader drop?"

"A guaranteed drop of one Abyss Admission Ticket, and a guaranteed drop of at least two pieces of the Abyss Woma Set. There's a certain chance of it dropping a perverted Abyss weapon on the level of Moon in the Well."

"Okay. We'll talk later, I'm going back to run the abyss. Take your time to consider."

Two in the morning.

Feng Tao said, "In servers one to five, the number of concurrent online players has dropped to between 400 and 600. Should we reopen the download link?"

"Go ahead, remember to make an announcement in the major game forums," Tao Chenggang said.

Yang Yuhui said, "I'll go contact the forum administrators to restore the links."

Chen Guiliang said, "Gang-ge and Uncle Feng, you guys go home and rest. I'll watch over things tonight. As for the brothers in charge of customer service and top-ups, a third of you can stay on duty. The rest should get some sleep."

"Alright," Tao Chenggang rubbed his face and said to his sister, "Let's go home."

Tao Xue was actually playing the private server on a computer. "I just learned how to play, I'm really getting into it."

"Let's go!" Tao Chenggang patted her on the head.

Tao Xue covered her head, stood up reluctantly, and pouted as she said goodbye to Chen Guiliang and the others.

After Tao Chenggang, Tao Xue, Feng Tao, and the others left, Xie Yang sat back down at a computer and carefully browsed through the posts from the past half-month.

County Magistrate Xie wanted to sort out his thoughts and review all of Chen Guiliang's moves.

He suddenly realized that some things were more fun than games.

Ah, truly a county magistrate, between playing games and "playing with" the real world, he preferred the latter. Chen Guiliang went straight to the sofa for a nap. If anything unexpected happened, the staff on duty would wake him.

When he woke up, it was already nine in the morning.

Yang Yuhui had sent his underlings to buy breakfast, and was waiting for the next shift to arrive and take over.

He also needed to get some sleep quickly. He had to get up at noon to continue the battle, as the number of players would increase again then.

Chen Guiliang was drinking soy milk and eating a bun when he patted Xie Yang, who was slumped over a computer desk, awake. "You've been here for the whole weekend?"

"Of course, it's so interesting," Xie Yang said as if it were the most natural thing in the world.

Before he finished breakfast, Tao Chenggang arrived. "The servers we contacted last night are usable now. We'll open another new server at twelve noon. I'll also add two more customer service staff."

"Tao Xue didn't come?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Tao Chenggang said, "She's sleeping in. It's finally Saturday, and she went to bed late last night. She'll definitely sleep until noon today. By the way, still no movement from Shanda?"

Chen Guiliang said, "It's impossible for Shanda to keep a group of professional hackers on their payroll long-term. The hackers they used to attack private servers last year were either hired temporarily or were the company's own network security personnel. In either case, deploying them requires going through procedures, unless CEO Chen gives his personal approval."

And what was CEO Chen doing?

He had gone to the capital for a meeting.

The joint crackdown on private servers and cheat plugins by the five ministries was not just for Shanda's benefit, but concerned all the game companies in the country.

The bosses of these game companies all had to make a trip to the capital to exchange relevant experiences and discuss how to coordinate with the special crackdown operation.

As for Zhang Yingfeng, who was in charge of copyright and legal affairs, he was also too busy to personally monitor the internet. He was busy gathering people to collect evidence in the real world.

What did cracking down on private servers and cheat plugins have to do with the real world?

This was naturally because the internet was not yet sufficiently developed. Even products related to online games still had a large number of physical counterfeiters!

For example, installation CDs with various versions of private servers burned onto them.

There were even criminal gangs that forged Shanda's physical point cards and posed as regional point card distributors to scam internet cafe managers and players.

These were the primary targets of the relevant authorities' crackdown. The private servers and cheat plugins online were actually secondary.

As noon approached, the number of players began to increase again.

After server six opened, new players who had just downloaded the game, along with a handful of players from the first five servers, quickly brought the online count in server six to over 400.

The other five servers had an average of over 500 players online.

The total number of players for Abyss Legend was definitely more than that.

For example, Jing-ye Fu Guoqiang and his friends had played all night and were now sound asleep.

After six in the evening, the number of online players skyrocketed again.

But the servers didn't lag, because the "locust players" had already left. They had purely been there to watch the excitement last night. A portion of them chose to stay, but most went back to doing whatever they were doing.

When Feng Tao arrived from the computer store, Yang Yuhui called Chen Guiliang, Tao Chenggang, and Feng Tao into the hallway.

He said in a low voice:

"Total top-ups in 24 hours: 33,875 yuan."

"Of that, internet cafe top-ups amounted to 10,465 yuan. The commission for each internet cafe is different, and after deducting inter-city, inter-bank transaction fees, we can get a little over 8,400 yuan."

"The other 23,410 yuan came from online banking and bank transfers. After deducting transaction fees, we can get a little over 22,000 yuan."

"The money from players who used post office remittances hasn't arrived yet, but the top-up amounts aren't large, so they can be ignored for now."

Feng Tao was surprised, "We actually made this much on the first day?"

Tao Chenggang said, "We haven't even recovered our costs yet. The promotion was too good, the netizens were too enthusiastic, and the game had to be perfected, which greatly increased the cost of building the private server's framework. Then there are the advertising fees for the major game forums, the rental fees for six thousand-person servers, and the salaries for customer service and the water army. These costs haven't even been factored in yet."

"It's mainly because we ran into a few whales," Yang Yuhui said. "These few people together topped up over ten thousand."

Chen Guiliang said, "Don't worry about Boss Shi, he has his own underlings. The other few whales must be well taken care of. Besides sending people to be their underlings, we also need to assign dedicated customer service to them. We must be responsive to their every need. If their game lags, give them a free game booster."

The four of them chatted briefly. Just as they returned to the command center, a customer service staffer excitedly said, "That President Shi wants to top up another 5,000!"

Feng Tao was surprised, "Did he already use up all the admission tickets he topped up for last night?"

"He used them up."

Tao Chenggang's childhood friend, who was acting as the GM, said, "I've been keeping an eye on it. President Shi's eight-person group has become a ten-person group. They logged off around six in the morning, started running instances again at two in the afternoon, and did their daily quests in the evening. After that, they took a break for over an hour, and now they're back to buy admission tickets for instance runs."

Chen Guiliang asked with a smile, "They must have completed the Abyss Woma Set by now, right?"

The GM said, "Out of the ten people, two of them still don't have the complete weapon set. They're not running the Woma instance anymore. Their last two runs were in the Abyss Zuma. Haha, the first time they went in, they got wiped. The second time, half of them died."

"As expected from the guy who sells Naobaijin, he's so damn rich!" Tao Chenggang exclaimed with emotion.

In fact, Boss Shi had gone to bed around midnight last night. All the subsequent instance runs were done by power-levelers.

When the power-levelers woke up, under Boss Shi's instructions, they called three more friends, forming a ten-person team to continue running instances.

It wasn't until past eight this evening that Boss Shi personally logged on to play, and casually topped up another 5,000 yuan for the private server.

The life of a rich person is just that dull and uninteresting.

(Offering a historical slice-of-life farming novel for sacrifice: Jin Dynasty Smoke and Fire: My Chaotic Everyday Life.)
